name: Large Mech Leg
description: A mech walker leg: hip, segments, knees, foot and actuators in one part. The gait brain walks it.

config.label: Gait profile
config.tooltip: Simple: it just walks. Basic: the gait settings. Advanced: each leg's own tuning too. The walker follows its leg with the highest profile.

config.label: Walk speed
config.tooltip: The top speed at full throttle, a share of what the legs walk at: 200 is twice as fast, with quicker steps, twice the power and a rougher ride. Every profile, Simple too. The walker follows its lead leg's, else any leg's changed one.

config.label: Stride
config.tooltip: How far each step reaches: longer strides walk faster. Basic and Advanced. The walker follows its leg with the highest profile.

config.label: Step height
config.tooltip: How high the feet lift: higher clears bigger obstacles. Basic and Advanced. The walker follows its leg with the highest profile.

config.label: Body height
config.tooltip: How high it stands (still no higher than the legs reach). Basic and Advanced. The walker follows its leg with the highest profile.

config.label: Gait
config.tooltip: Auto: a tripod with six or more legs in an even count, else a wave. Tripod: half the legs at a time. Wave: one leg at a time. The walker follows its leg with the highest profile.

config.label: Leg pace
config.tooltip: This leg's step speed. Advanced profile only.

config.label: Leg lift
config.tooltip: How high this leg lifts its foot, on top of the step height. Advanced profile only.

config.label: Leg spread
config.tooltip: How far out this leg puts its foot. Advanced profile only.

config.label: Gait group
config.tooltip: In a tripod, which half this leg steps with. Advanced profile only.
